articles.author: Jacob Fisher
articles.title: Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra to get major display upgrade - Notebookcheck
articles.description: Samsung’s Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra are reportedly set to receive M16 OLED panels, promising improved brightness, color accuracy, efficiency, durability and new privacy features. The standard S27 models, however, are expected to use older M14 technology.
